Black Basta affiliates use tools such as SoftPerfect network scanner (netscan.exe) to conduct network scanning.
Black Basta affiliates use credential scraping tools like Mimikatz for privilege escalation.

According to cybersecurity researchers, Black Basta affiliates have also exploited ZeroLogon (CVE-2020-1472 [CWE-330]), NoPac (CVE-2021-42278 [CWE-20] and CVE-2021-42287 [CWE-269]), and PrintNightmare (CVE-2021-34527 [CWE-269]) vulnerabilities for local and Windows Active Domain privilege escalation [T1068].[1],[2]
